dedupe_keys.name: upto urban patch and energyplus input generators

description: The UPTO research team publishes four Python code examples for preparing city-scale building-energy inputs. Two scripts construct UrbanPatch neighbourhoods around tiles or buildings with a selected receptive radius. A third generates tile-scale microclimate information, and a fourth produces EnergyPlus IDF files. The repository names RDFLib, Geomeppy, UWG, OSMnx and OSMsc as dependencies and supplies source free under MIT. Its companion dataset covers 30 US cities, while the code can operate on compatible urban-object inputs without a fixed simulation horizon. It directly prepares inputs for model-energyplus. A caveat is that these examples are not a complete calibrated model of every building: users still need physical properties, operating schedules and suitable weather assumptions. The documentation was inspected, but dependency installation, generated IDF validity and simulation results were not tested.
